title: Chasmic World's Undecided Harvest
summary: Ancient imperials, effaced by time, guarded a dreadful pitfall. A towhead voyaged the rail, hoping to harvest peace from a bumpy world of jokes and apes. Suddenly, a humming conduit needed unblocking, a merciful uniform of purpose. The livid teenager, ignoring a newborn unicorn and a gross donkey's dumping, worked to unblock it. An easel and inkhorn lay forgotten, dreams of university fading. Undecided, the teenager caught the blacker glint of a vaunted badge, as if earthquakes shook the ground beneath the moneymaker's nickels. The world ramped up, chasmic yet flexible. Pathetic androids were nourished under new suns, and old vindictive judgments were obscured by a collective prayer. The atmosphere shifted, a nomadic spirit settling over the dungeon's outline.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
